battle.name: 蒙金戰爭
battle.brief: 一二一一年成吉思汗以報父祖之仇為名率蒙古軍東下，突破金廷三百公里界壕，八月會戰野狐嶺，木華黎率八魯營自獾兒嘴通道下馬步戰，擊潰完顏承裕統率的三十萬主力，繼而追至澮河堡盡殘兵。金廷以猛火油守城、蒙古以火箭攻城，但卡面這件希臘火屬拜占庭國家機密，從未出現在華北戰場。

kit.name: 希臘火
kit.history: 配在銅管裡的燃燒劑。配方是帝國的機密，配方和船一起沉了。

countries: 交戰的兩方是金朝與大蒙古國，中間夾著一群不斷改換旗幟的契丹與漢人武裝。南線的金朝是完顏氏女真建立的政權，疆域北起大興安嶺與外興安嶺，南至淮河、汴京，西抵六盤山，東臨日本海；一二一一年在位者為衛紹王完顏永濟，其兄金章宗完顏璟於一二〇八年病死，在位不過十餘年。金的兵制以女真猛安謀克為骨幹，漢地州縣靠編戶與漢軍，北面邊線另有契丹、室韋等部落的附庸軍；樞密院掌軍令，六處行省與各路統軍司分屯河北、山東、河東、遼東，雲內、武州、朔州等邊州屯有重兵。蒙古方面，一二〇六年鐵木真統一草原諸部，被尊為成吉思汗，其軍由怯薛宿衛、探馬赤軍與各部徵發的騎兵構成，編為十戶、百戶、千戶、萬戶，戰時以萬戶長為統帥，木華黎所領的八魯營是其中最精銳的突擊部隊。蒙古在戰事中不斷吸收金境內的歸附者，史載蒙軍之中有四萬名漢人與三萬名契丹叛逃者；契丹人另起東遼國於遼陽一帶，漢人則有河北九公以紅襖為號抗拒蒙古。南宋在整場戰爭中坐觀成敗，直到一二三三年孟珙率二萬人、運米三十萬石北上，才與蒙古聯手攻金。
countriesEn: The two sides were the Jin dynasty and the Great Mongol state, with a shifting body of Khitan and Han Chinese armed groups caught between them. On the southern side the Jin was a state founded by the Jurchen Wanyan clan, whose territory ran from the Greater and Lesser Khingan in the north to the Huai River and Bianjing in the south, from the Liupan Mountains in the west to the Sea of Japan in the east; the ruler in 1211 was the Prince of Wei, Wanyan Yongji, whose elder brother the Emperor Zhangzong, Wanyan Jing, had died in 1208 after barely a decade on the throne. The Jin military system rested on the Jurchen meng'an mouke households, supplemented by registered Han households and Han troops in the Chinese districts, while the northern frontier relied on the contingent forces of subordinate Khitan and Jurchen tribes; the Privy Council issued the orders, and six provincial administrations and the circuit commands in Hebei, Shandong, Hedong and Liaodong held the garrisons, with heavy forces in the border prefectures of Yunnei, Wuzhou and Shuozhou. On the Mongolian side, Temüjin united the steppe tribes in 1206 and was raised on a shield as Genghis Khan; his army was made up of the keshig guard, the dark-man cavalry and the horse levies of the tribes, organised in units of ten, hundred, thousand and ten thousand households, with a commander of ten thousand men at the head of an army in the field, and the eight-lu camp of Muqali was its finest shock troops. The Mongols kept absorbing defectors from Jin territory as the war went on: the records speak of forty thousand Han Chinese and thirty thousand Khitan fugitives serving in the Mongol ranks; the Khitans raised a state of their own in Liaodong and around Guangning, while the Han formed the red-jacket armies in Hebei that resisted the Mongols. The Southern Song watched the whole contest from the sidelines until 1233, when Meng Gong marched north with twenty thousand men and three hundred thousand measures of rice and joined the Mongols against the Jin.
people: 全場最關鍵的兩個人物分屬兩邊。蒙古的成吉思汗鐵木真一二〇六年統一草原，一二一一年以報父祖之仇為名揮師南下，八月在野狐嶺親統主力破金軍，又在澮河堡以三千精騎掩護總攻，完顏承裕僅以身免；一二一三至一二一四年他分三路大舉，兵鋒直抵中都，一二一五年授木華黎太師之號令其經略中原，一二二七年病逝於西征途中。木華黎是這場戰爭真正的執行者，野狐嶺之役他率八魯營自獾兒嘴通道突擊，下馬步戰直逼金軍中營；三五年間轉戰河東、河北、山東、陝西，一二一八年再取太原，二二〇年下濟南與益都，二二二年取濮陽，二二三年進逼長安，同年病卒。哲別於一二一二年率軍攻下東京路遼陽；窩闊台、察合台、術赤一二一一年分兵西取雲內、東勝、武州、朔州以牽制金軍；拖雷在烏沙堡與中都兩役中擔任中路主將，一二三一年更率眾騎假道宋境漢中南下。金廷方面，獨吉思忠是首任丞相，調七十五萬人加固三百公里界壕，兵敗後由完顏承裕接任；契丹人石抹明安奉命議和卻叛降成吉思汗，泄露金軍布陣，完顏九斤戰歿，徒單鎰以文人出任第三任丞相，勉強止住崩勢。完顏永濟在一二一三年被完顏濟王弒殺，宣宗完顏允恭即位，其後哀宗完顏守緒終於一二三四年自縊於蔡州。
peopleEn: The two figures who mattered most stood on opposite sides. On the Mongol side, Genghis Khan Temüjin united the steppe in 1206 and in 1211 marched east under the banner of avenging his fathers and his ancestors; in August he led the main force at Yehuling, and at the Huanhe fort he covered the general assault with three thousand picked riders, so that Wanyan Chengyu escaped with nothing but his life. In 1213 and 1214 he drove three columns deep into Jin territory as far as Zhongdu, and in 1215 he gave Muqali the title of Grand Preceptor and set him to administer the Central Plains; he died in 1227 on the way back from his western campaign. The man who actually executed the war was Muqali. At Yehuling he led the eight-lu camp through the Huanerzui pass, dismounting to fight on foot and pressing straight at the Jin centre; over the following three and a half years he campaigned in Hedong, Hebei, Shandong and Shaanxi, taking Taiyuan again in 1218, Jinan and Yidu in 1220, Puyang in 1222 and pressing on to Chang'an in 1223, where he died that same year. Jebe took Liaoyang in the Dongjing circuit in 1212; Ogedei, Chagatai and Jochi struck west in 1211 to seize Yunnei, Dongsheng, Wuzhou and Shuozhou in order to pin the Jin there; Tolui led the central column at the battles of Wusha and Zhongdu, and in 1231 marched south with a mounted force through the Song territory of Hanzhong. On the Jin side, Dujisi was the first chancellor, raising seventy-five thousand men to strengthen three hundred kilometres of frontier trench; after the defeat Wanyan Chengyu took over from him. The Khitan Shimo Ming'an was sent to negotiate and instead went over to Genghis Khan, handing over the Jin deployment; Wanyan Jiujin fell in the fighting; and Dandan Yi, a scholar, was appointed the third chancellor and managed to check the collapse for a while. Wanyan Yongji was killed in 1213 by the Prince of Ji, the Emperor Xuanzong Wanyan Yungong succeeded him, and his successor the Emperor Aizong Wanyan Shouxu hanged himself at Caizhou in 1234.
kits: 卡面這件希臘火並沒有出現在蒙金戰場上。它是拜占庭帝國自七世紀六十年代起守住的國家機密，配方藏於宮廷配方書中，裝在銅管與黃銅噴嘴裡，由操作者用管口噴出點燃的油基燃燒劑，一次可覆蓋一條船或一段城頭。二〇四年第四次十字軍攻陷君士坦丁堡，配方工匠流散到威尼斯與熱那亞，此後這門技術在拉丁海權手中以另一副面貌延續，直到一二九一年阿卡圍城才最後一次大規模用於攻城。與它同一技術家族、卻真正出現在一二一一至一二三四年北方戰線上的，是金朝的猛火油與火油罐、霹靂火球，以及蒙古的火箭與擲油瓶：金人有《金史》與《武經總要》所記的猛火油，攻城時順著雲梯與攻車送上城頭，用來燒毀蒙古的攻城塔與帆布；蒙古的火箭把浸過油的麻布纏在箭簇上，用來覆蓋城頭的守軍。希臘火與它們的差別在載體與用法：銅管手持噴射，靠的是連續、精準、射程十餘步；油罐擲擲靠的是數十步內的覆蓋面積，一次能燒一片牆根。一二一四至一二一五年蒙古軍攻中都時焚燒城郊，二三四年蔡州圍城時蒙古用穿穴、懸梯與雲梯同時進攻，也曾縱火燒毀城樓；這些火攻用的都是蒙古自帶的油與箭，與拜占庭的配方毫無關係。
kitsEn: The Greek fire on the card was not present on any battlefield of the Mongol-Jin war. It was a state secret the Byzantine Empire had guarded since the seventh century, its formula kept in the imperial recipe books and its mixture carried in copper pipes and brass nozzles, so that an operator could spray an ignited oil-based burning charge from the mouth of the pipe and cover a ship or a stretch of wall in one throw. When the Fourth Crusade took Constantinople in 1204 the craftsmen who knew the formula scattered to Venice and Genoa, and the craft continued in Latin hands under a different aspect, until the siege of Acre in 1291 saw its last large-scale use in siege warfare. The members of the same technical family that did appear on the northern front between 1211 and 1234 were the Jin naphtha, oil jars and thunder-crash bombs, and the Mongol fire arrows and thrown oil flasks. The Jin had the naphtha recorded in the History of Jin and in the Wujing Zongyao, carried up to the wall along scaling ladders and siege towers to burn the Mongols' siege frames and their canvas; the Mongols bound oil-soaked hemp around the heads of their arrows to blanket the defenders on the wall. The difference between Greek fire and these lay in the carrier and in the method of use. The copper pipe was held in the hand and sprayed, and what it gave was continuity, precision and a range of a dozen paces or so; the thrown oil jar gave coverage within a few dozen paces, burning a stretch of wall base in a single blow. When the Mongols attacked Zhongdu in 1214 and 1215 they burned the suburbs, and in the siege of Caizhou in 1234 they attacked at the same time through mined passages, scaling ladders and assault towers, setting fires against the wall towers; all of this fire was worked with oil and arrows the Mongols brought with them, and had nothing to do with the Byzantine formula.
tactics: 蒙古的野狐嶺打法可以拆成三步。第一步是拆掉金廷的屏障：金朝沿蒙金邊界挖出長達三百公里的困馬溝界壕，蒙古便以三子窩闊台分兵攻打西京大同，把金軍主力吸在西北，自己親率大軍正面突破烏沙堡，戰事自三月打到六月底，再休整一個月。第二步是情報先行：金遣契丹人石抹明安來議和，石抹明安轉而投蒙古，供出金軍布陣。第三步是集中一點破全線：木華黎率八魯營自獾兒嘴通道切入，蒙古軍因地勢下馬步戰，並在戰前釋放一批死囚充當前鋒帶罪立功，直逼完顏承裕的中軍大營；金軍因各部過於分散、調度失靈而全線崩潰，指揮官完顏九斤陣亡。追擊同樣是計畫的一部分，完顏承裕收攏數萬殘兵在澮河堡再戰三日，成吉思汗以三千精騎突擊掩護，數萬騎兵隨後總攻。金軍此後再無類似部署，蒙古的整體戰略則是避實擊虛、斷糧道而不急於攻城：一二一五年起木華黎以河北山東為基地，實行屯田與括戶，逐步把遊牧式的掠奪戰變成占領與治理；一二三二年的三峰山一役，蒙古先斷糧道，再誘敵深入，在金軍回師疲憊時全軍衝鋒，金軍十餘萬一朝潰散；一二三四年蔡州則靠穿穴挖地道與懸梯同時進攻。守城的金廷倚靠界壕、密集列陣與城頭的猛火油反制攻城器械，兩者在武器上各有所長，在組織與速度上卻完全不是一個量級。
tacticsEn: The Mongol method at Yehuling can be broken into three steps. The first was to break the Jin screen: the Jin had dug a continuous horse-holding trench, the kuma gou, three hundred kilometres long along the Mongol-Jin border, so the Mongols sent the third son Ogedei with a detachment to attack Xijing, Datong, drawing the main weight of the Jin army to the northwest while the khan himself took the main body straight through the defences at Wusha, fighting from March to the end of June and then resting for a month. The second step was intelligence: the Jin sent the Khitan Shimo Ming'an to negotiate, and Shimo Ming'an went over to the Mongols instead and supplied the Jin deployment. The third step was to break the whole line at one point: Muqali led the eight-lu camp in through the Huanerzui pass, the Mongol horsemen dismounting to fight on foot because of the ground, and before the assault they released a batch of condemned men to serve as the vanguard and win their lives; the pressure fell on Wanyan Chengyu's central camp, and the Jin collapsed along the whole front because the separate contingents were too dispersed to be coordinated, the commander Wanyan Jiujin falling in the fighting. The pursuit was part of the plan as well. Wanyan Chengyu gathered several tens of thousands of survivors and fought again for three days at the Huanhe fort, where Genghis Khan covered the general assault with three thousand picked riders and the mass of the cavalry struck afterwards. The Jin never mounted a comparable deployment again. The wider Mongol strategy was to avoid the strong, cut the supply lines, and not to hurry at sieges: from 1215 Muqali used Hebei and Shandong as a base, introduced military farms and the registration of households, and gradually turned nomadic plunder into occupation and government; in the battle of Sanfengshan in 1232 the Mongols first cut the grain road, then drew the enemy deep in, and charged with the whole army when the Jin was exhausted and withdrawing, and more than a hundred thousand men broke up in a single day; at Caizhou in 1234 they worked at the same time through mined passages and scaling ladders. The Jin, defending the city, relied on the trench, on dense battle lines and on naphtha poured from the wall against the assault equipment. The two sides had their own strengths in weapons, but in organisation and in speed they were not in the same order of magnitude.
data: 本役的數字必須分開看待。正史與蒙古秘史式的記載常把兵數寫得極大：野狐嶺一戰，古籍稱金軍出動近五十萬、蒙古軍約十萬；史家李則芬的估算則認為金軍實際約三萬至四萬，蒙古軍少於金軍，金軍二十萬以上的傷亡數字屬嚴重誇大，蒙古軍損失不到兩萬。蒙古方面的動員能力，一二一一年大蒙古國人口約七十萬，軍隊十五萬，其中本部蒙古軍十萬；同年金朝有八百四十一萬戶、五千三百多萬人，軍隊號稱百萬；南宋人口約八千萬，軍隊約八十萬。守成方面，金廷以七十五萬人加固三百公里界壕，完顏承裕率三十萬主力放棄恆州、昌州、撫州退守野狐嶺，說明金軍總量遠大於蒙古，但調度與戰鬥力不成比例。一二一三年懷來之戰後蒙古兵鋒抵達中都，野狐嶺距中都約一百五十公里。蒙古軍攻中都凡兩次，計有一二一二、一二一四至一二一五。一二二一年起木華黎經營河東河北，至一二二三年進逼長安。一二三一年蒙古假道宋境迂迴南下，一二三三年孟珙率二萬人、運米三十萬石北上蔡州，一二三四年二月蔡州城破，金朝滅亡。卡面這件希臘火的可查數字則在另一條線上：配方問世於七世紀六十年代，銅管一次噴射的覆蓋約十餘步，最後一次大規模攻城使用是一二九一年阿卡。
dataEn: The figures of this campaign have to be sorted before they can be used. The dynastic and chronicle accounts habitually write the numbers very large: at Yehuling the old books put the Jin army at close to five hundred thousand and the Mongol army at about a hundred thousand, while the historian Li Zefen's estimate is that the Jin force was in fact some thirty to forty thousand men, fewer than the Mongols, that the figure of more than two hundred thousand Jin casualties is severely exaggerated, and that the Mongols lost fewer than twenty thousand. As for the Mongol capacity to mobilise, in 1211 the Great Mongol state had a population of about seven hundred thousand and an army of one hundred and fifty thousand, of which a hundred thousand were the Mongol proper; in the same year the Jin had 8,413,164 households and 53,532,925 people with an army reckoned at a million; the Southern Song had about eighty million people and eight hundred thousand men. On the defensive side the Jin had put seventy-five thousand men to work on three hundred kilometres of frontier trench, and Wanyan Chengyu brought thirty thousand men back to Yehuling after abandoning the prefectures of Hengzhou, Changzhou and Fuzhou, which shows the Jin total strength was far greater than the Mongol one, yet that command and fighting quality were not in the same proportion. After the battle of Huailai in 1213 the Mongol spearhead reached Zhongdu, about one hundred and fifty kilometres from Yehuling. The Mongols attacked Zhongdu twice, in 1212 and again from 1214 to 1215. From 1221 Muqali worked on Hedong and Hebei, and by 1223 he was pressing on Chang'an. In 1231 the Mongols swung south through Song territory, in 1233 Meng Gong took twenty thousand men and three hundred thousand measures of rice north to Caizhou, and in the second month of 1234 Caizhou fell and the Jin was extinguished. The traceable figures for the Greek fire on the card lie on a different line: the formula dates from the seventh century sixties, one discharge of the copper pipe covered a dozen paces or so, and the last large-scale use in a siege was at Acre in 1291.
cause: 這場戰爭不是一天決定的，它有二十年的積累。金朝自金章宗以來對草原各部採取分化、收買、罰沒的政策，把蒙古各部的首領逐一拉攏或消滅，企圖用草原的內部矛盾替代直接開戰；一百一十四六年俺巴孩汗被塔塔兒人誘捕後送入金廷，金熙宗下令把他釘死在木驢之上，這筆血債在蒙古部族的記憶裡存了一個多世紀，到成吉思汗手裡成了最現成的號召。金朝還在邊界上長期抓捕逃入的蒙古人，扣留商旅與使者，蒙古與金廷的往來屢次斷裂，一二〇六年前後的一次斷裂更直接讓成吉思汗決定動手。蒙古自身的理由同樣清楚：鐵木真統一草原後，人力與畜群都吃緊，南方富庶的金朝既能提供戰俘、匠人、糧食與鐵器，也能提供進攻的目標；蒙古於是先把金朝扶持的汪古部收編，用聯姻穩住北方，並占領陰山以北作為屯糧積兵的主基地，鋪好南下的跳板。衛紹王完顏永濟在位時疏於邊務，金廷自恃帶甲百萬、耽於太平，界壕雖在，人心與準備都不在。成吉思汗不接金廷的議和文書，因為他要的不是和平，而是藉一場勝利把金朝從草原的支柱上打下來。
causeEn: This war was not decided in a day; it had twenty years of accumulation behind it. From the reign of Emperor Zhangzong the Jin had pursued a policy of dividing, buying and confiscating among the steppe tribes, pulling the chiefs of the Mongol clans over one by one or removing them, in the hope that the internal contradictions of the steppe would do the work of a war. In 1146 Anbaqai Khan was tricked by the Tatars, handed over to the Jin court and nailed alive to a wooden donkey by order of Emperor Xizong; that blood debt was carried in the memory of the Mongol clans for more than a century, and in the hands of Genghis Khan it became the most ready of summons. The Jin also hunted down Mongols who fled across the frontier, detained merchants and envoys, and the intercourse between the two states was repeatedly broken; one such rupture around 1206 moved Genghis Khan to act at once. The Mongol side had reasons that were equally plain. Once the steppe was united, manpower and herds were short, and the rich Jin state to the south could supply prisoners, craftsmen, grain and iron, and could serve as the target of attack. The Mongols therefore took in the Wanyan-derived Ongut tribe that the Jin had patronised, held the north steady by marriage, and occupied the ground north of the Yin mountains as a main depot for grain and troops, laying the springboard for the march south. The Prince of Wei, Wanyan Yongji, was negligent on the frontier while he reigned; the court at Jin, confident in its million men and content with peace, had the trench but neither the morale nor the preparation. Genghis Khan would not take the Jin court's proposals for negotiation, because what he wanted was not peace but a victory that would bring the Jin down from its place as the pillar of the steppe.
impact: 野狐嶺一役改變的不只是戰場。蒙古在華北取得的勝利立刻轉化成對金朝內部的壓力：金廷的將領不再敢主戰，完顏永濟的荒政與對蒙古的軟弱態度激起宮廷政變，一二一三年完顏濟王弒君奪位，一二一四年金廷被迫遷都汴京，北方防線從此崩解，河北、山東、河東、陝西的大片州縣在二十年裡陸續淪陷。戰爭也製造了新的政治力量：契丹人趁亂在遼東與廣寧一帶重建東遼，漢人在河北組成紅襖軍抗蒙；南宋則在金亡之後失去屏障，北方不再是緩衝地，端平入洛的爭議隨即把宋蒙推到直接對抗，數十年後才有漁陽之難與襄樊的結局。技術與人口的流動同樣深遠，數萬漢人與契丹人被蒙古編入軍籍，耶律楚材在一二一八年應召入帳，木華黎在河北推行括戶與屯田，蒙古由此從劫掠式征服轉向以漢地制度治漢地；金朝掌握的火藥與猛火油技術也隨俘虜與工匠流入蒙古，成為元朝火器譜系上一條可追溯的線。而卡面這件希臘火正站在這條線的對面：蒙古人始終沒有得到拜占庭的配方，他們的火油技術來自中國與伊斯蘭世界，直到一二七四年與一二八一年攻日本時才以火油拋擲的形式出現在海戰裡。技術的傳播靠的是俘虜、商人與戰場，不是配方書。
impactEn: The battle of Yehuling changed more than a battlefield. The Mongol victory in North China was turned at once into pressure on the inside of the Jin state: the generals of the court no longer dared to advocate war, the misgovernment of Wanyan Yongji and his softness towards the Mongols provoked a palace coup, in 1213 the Prince of Ji killed the emperor and seized the throne, and in 1214 the Jin court was forced to move its capital to Bianjing. The northern line of defence collapsed from that point, and large stretches of Hebei, Shandong, Hedong and Shaanxi fell away one by one over the following twenty years. The war also created new political forces: the Khitans rebuilt a state of their own in Liaodong and around Guangning, and the Han in Hebei formed the red-jacket armies that resisted the Mongols. The Southern Song, once the Jin was gone, had lost its screen; the north was no longer a buffer, the quarrel over the Song advance on Luoyang in 1234 pushed Song and Mongol into direct war, and it was only decades later that the disaster at Yuyang and the siege of Xiangyang followed. The movement of people and techniques was just as deep. Tens of thousands of Han Chinese and Khitans were entered on the Mongol rolls, Yelü Chucai entered the khan's service in 1218, and Muqali carried out the registration of households and the military farms in Hebei, so that the Mongols turned from a conquest of plunder to a rule of the Chinese districts by Chinese institutions. The powder and naphtha technique of the Jin also flowed into Mongol hands with prisoners and craftsmen, and became a traceable strand in the lineage of Yuan firearms. The Greek fire on the card stands on the other side of that strand. The Mongols never obtained the Byzantine formula; their oil technique came from China and from the Islamic world, and only in 1274 and 1281, in the invasions of Japan, did it appear in naval battle as thrown burning oil. Technique travels through prisoners, merchants and battlefields, not through recipe books.
result: 結果是金朝被從北方抹去。野狐嶺之後蒙古取得節奏：一二一三年三路大舉再取懷來、紫陽關、涿郡、真定與東京路遼陽等處，兵鋒直抵中都城下，金廷於一二一四年遷都汴京，一二一五年蒙古軍再攻中都，焚燒城郊與宮室，北方名都一度成焦土；一二一五年成吉思汗授木華黎太師，命其經略中原，木華黎以八魯營舊部為核心，十年之間取太原、濟南、益都、濮陽、長安、潼關，金朝只剩下河南與關中。一二二三年木華黎病卒，一二二七年成吉思汗崩於西征途中，一二三一年窩闊台再舉大軍，拖雷率眾騎假道宋境漢中迂迴插入金軍背後，金朝腹背受敵。一二三二年三峰山之役，金軍十餘萬在潰退中覆沒，樞密副使完顏合達、移剌蒲阿等大將皆死，史載以強弩聞名的精兵忠孝軍於此全軍盡墨；金朝自此再無可用之兵，只剩汴京、歸德、蔡州數座孤城。一二三四年初蒙古軍進抵蔡州，南宋孟珙所部亦至，城破之日金哀宗完顏守緒在幽蘭軒自縊，末帝完顏承麟出戰而歿；史載哀宗遺體被火焚後為宋軍所得，剖分兩體，一與蒙古，一與南宋。金朝亡於此，華北盡歸蒙古，此後元朝的天下只差南宋一面。
resultEn: The result was that the Jin was erased from the north. After Yehuling the Mongols set the tempo: in 1213 the three columns took Huai-lai, Ziyang Pass, Zhuojun, Zhending and Liaoyang in the Dongjing circuit, the spearhead reaching the walls of Zhongdu; the Jin court moved its capital to Bianjing in 1214, and in 1215 the Mongols attacked Zhongdu again and burned the suburbs and the palace quarter, so that the northern capital was for a time a field of fire. In 1215 Genghis Khan gave Muqali the title of Grand Preceptor and ordered him to administer the Central Plains; taking the old eight-lu camp as his core, Muqali in ten years took Taiyuan, Jinan, Yidu, Puyang, Chang'an and Tongguan, and the Jin was left with Henan and the Guanzhong basin alone. Muqali died of illness in 1223, Genghis Khan died on his western campaign in 1227, and in 1231 Ogedei raised a great army again, Tolui taking his mounted force through the Song territory of Hanzhong and around behind the Jin, so that the Jin was attacked from front and rear. At the battle of Sanfengshan in 1232 more than a hundred thousand Jin troops were destroyed as they broke off, the Vice-Privy Councillor Wanyan Heda and Yelu Pug among the great commanders falling, and the records have it that the famed crossbowmen of the Loyal and Filial Army, the elite of the Jin, were wiped out there. From then the Jin had no serviceable troops left and only the isolated cities of Bianjing, Guide and Caizhou. Early in 1234 the Mongol army reached Caizhou, where the Southern Song force of Meng Gong had also arrived, and on the day the city fell the Emperor Aizong Wanyan Shouxu hanged himself in the Youlan Hall and the last emperor, Wanyan Chenglin, was killed going into battle. The records have it that Aizong's body was burned and taken by the Song troops, cut into two, one part given to the Mongols and one to the Southern Song. There the Jin ended, the North China plain passed entirely to the Mongols, and from then on the Yuan empire had only the Southern Song left to subdue.
